data.name: Shivanshuva
data.gender_notes: Shivanshuva is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Shivanshuva is a unisex Hindu name that means 'The Protector of Lord Shiva'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Shiva' (the Hindu god of destruction) and 'Anshu' (protector). The name Shivanshuva carries the meaning “The Protector of Lord Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Shivanshuva usually hope their child will grow to embody the protector of lord shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Shivanshuva belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Protector of Lord Shiva.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shivanshuva total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shivanshuva carries a significant cultural importance in Hinduism, as it is a testimony to the deep reverence and devotion towards Lord Shiva, one of the primary deities in the Hindu pantheon. This name reflects the strong connection between the individual and the divine, emphasizing the protective role of the deity over his followers. Shivanshuva is often bestowed upon children as a mark of their infusion into this legacy of faith, further strengthening the bond between the family, the community, and the god they worship.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, Shivanshuva represents the embodiment of devotion, protection, and fearlessness. By invoking the blessings of Lord Shiva as the protector, the holder of this name is expected to lead a life guided by righteousness and courage. Lord Shiva is also considered the deviation of destruction and transformation, signifying the constant regeneration and evolution of the soul. The name serves as a daily reminder to its bearer of the divine presence within them, inspiring them to tap into their inner strength and resilience as they navigate the journey of life.
